plugin_desc: Hirschmann Classic industrial switch SNMP collection (enterprise PEN 248, HMPRIV-MGMT-SNMP-MIB hmConfiguration). Device identity is the sysObjectID prefix 1.3.6.1.4.1.248 on the Classic resource tree (248.14); HiOS IT 248.100 is out of scope. Collects CPU utilization as a 0-100 percent (hmCpuUtilization, with optional hmCpuAverageUtilization over up to 30 minutes) and memory allocated/free as kilobytes converted to bytes in the metric query, with utilization derived as allocated/(allocated+free). Chassis temperature comes from the hmTemperature scalar (degrees Celsius). Fan operational state comes from the hmFanTable (hmFanState ok(1) normalized to 1=ok / 2=failed). Interface traffic comes from the built-in IF-MIB table. Some firmware requires hmEnableMeasurement 1.3.6.1.4.1.248.14.2.15.1.0 = enable(1) before resource gauges populate. This plugin does not share discovery or OIDs with switch_ruggedcom (PEN 15004) or switch_westermo (PEN 16177) and does not poll VLAN/PTP/traps or treat hmIfaceUtilization as CPU.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the current CPU utilization of the Hirschmann Classic switch (hmCpuUtilization) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, ring-protocol instability, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_avg
metrics.description: This metric reports the average CPU utilization of the Hirschmann Classic switch (hmCpuAverageUtilization) as a 0-100 percentage, measured over at most the last 30 minutes. It is a longer-window companion to the headline CPU metric.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the allocated memory of the Hirschmann Classic switch in bytes (hmMemoryAllocated, converted from kilobytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free memory of the Hirschmann Classic switch in bytes (hmMemoryFree, converted from kilobytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Hirschmann Classic switch, computed as allocated / (allocated + free) * 100. Vendor kilobyte units cancel in the ratio. High memory usage may indicate leaks, oversized MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the chassis temperature of the Hirschmann Classic switch (hmTemperature) in degrees Celsius. Sustained high temperature can indicate cooling failure or an overheated environment.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Hirschmann Classic cooling fan (hmFanState). Values are normalized to 1=ok / 2=failed. A non-normal state indicates a cooling fault that can quickly lead to overheating.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
